author: Disney
description:
What if Alice had to return to Wonderland to save it from destruction?

A reimagined darker story of Disney’s Alice in Wonderland told through silhouette and animation. 

Inspired by The New York Times Best-Selling Series, A Twisted Tale, available wherever books are sold. 

Production by: Wild Comet Media, Lucy Animation Studio, Formidable Studio, Animales del Sur.
